accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, quiz choices, accordions, and price tags MUST contain data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="hero-gold-cta-button").
accessibility_and_testing.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion animations with reduced motion checks or use simple opacity fades when requested.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning single-page React frontend in /app/frontend/src/App.js or modularized under src/components/.
Ensure the primary CTA strictly uses gold #F4C95D with hover lift and glowing shadow, pointing to https://rzp.io/rzp/webinarregistration9.
Strictly follow the alternating dark/light section background rhythm.
Include every single section listed from 1 to 20 with high fidelity design.
Create interactive Suha AI quiz and character with framer-motion.
Maintain strict data-testid compliance on all clickable and interactive elements.
